evidence_note: Classes cover designed syntax and semantic failure corpora. They do not measure how often any model produces an error.

classes.failure_signal: A declaration or scoped construct loses its required typed close.
classes.compiler_prevention: Report the expected block kind at the local recovery anchor and retain an error node.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Restore only the missing close; do not move or delete the following definition.

classes.failure_signal: A match arm, type argument, call, or parameter list loses one required delimiter.
classes.compiler_prevention: Name the missing delimiter and recover at the containing construct rather than rewriting the expression.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Insert the single missing delimiter without changing names, values, order, or behavior.

classes.failure_signal: Values with different numeric or nominal identities are mixed or converted implicitly.
classes.compiler_prevention: Reject before lowering and show expected/found nominal types with an explicit-conversion hint only when semantics permit.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Do not add an implicit cast or unwrap the nominal type; repair the source value or use an explicit approved conversion.

classes.failure_signal: A record construction omits/adds a field or violates a declared invariant.
classes.compiler_prevention: Check the nominal schema and invariant at construction with the exact field or expression as the primary cause.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Preserve the nominal type and business invariant; never silence the error by dropping fields or weakening the contract.

classes.failure_signal: A sealed match misses a case, hides future cases behind a wildcard, or contains an unreachable arm.
classes.compiler_prevention: Compute sealed coverage and name the missing, hidden, or already-covered case.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Add or correct explicit arms; do not introduce a wildcard that hides variants.

classes.failure_signal: A Result is ignored, propagated across incompatible error types, or mapped incompletely/catch-all.
classes.compiler_prevention: Keep success, domain error, cancellation, and trap channels distinct and require total explicit mapping.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Handle, return, propagate the same error type, or provide a total variant mapping; do not catch all or erase payloads.

classes.failure_signal: A function performs an effect or uses a capability absent from its declared boundary.
classes.compiler_prevention: Compare inferred calls with explicit effect/capability sets and reject at the boundary.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Add only the actually required declaration or remove the operation; do not grant broader capabilities.

classes.failure_signal: An affine resource is used after move or after close.
classes.compiler_prevention: Track ownership state and point to the move/close that consumed the resource.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Reorder ownership or borrow within its valid scope; never clone a resource handle or remove cleanup.

classes.failure_signal: A Future is consumed twice or a Task escapes its lexical task group.
classes.compiler_prevention: Treat Future/Task handles as affine and validate parent scope ownership.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Await once and keep child tasks inside the group; do not detach or duplicate handles.

classes.failure_signal: A Stream is collected without an explicit bound or an async stream operation is used without await.
classes.compiler_prevention: Require a finite collection limit and preserve the Future result type until awaited.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Add a justified explicit bound or await; do not convert the stream to an unbounded list.

classes.failure_signal: Package version metadata enters a type or a Component trap channel is collapsed into a domain Result.
classes.compiler_prevention: Keep WIT/package versioning and ComponentCall outcomes separate from language generics and domain errors.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Move version constraints to package metadata and handle trap/limit separately; do not relabel them as domain variants.

classes.failure_signal: A write omits the expected revision or applies a stale load without comparing revisions.
classes.compiler_prevention: Require revision in commit contracts and make stale-result comparison part of the checked flow.
classes.ai_repair_constraint: Thread and compare the actual revision; never bypass optimistic concurrency with a default or latest value.
